create_KubricMovifDataset: create a KubricMovifDataset instance to load and sample video sequences with 2D point trajectories from a data root directory
create_CoTrackerDataset: create a CoTrackerDataset base class instance to configure photometric and spatial augmentation parameters for video trajectory data
run_add_photometric_augs: run photometric augmentations including eraser occlusion, patch replacement, color jitter, and Gaussian blur on video frames and trajectories
run_add_spatial_augs: run spatial augmentations including random padding, scaling, stretching, cropping, and flipping on video frames and trajectory coordinates
run_crop: run a simple random crop on video frames and adjust corresponding trajectory coordinates to match the cropped region
